answer: Suppose every newcomer must be planted in the garden of a sponsor: each established agent owns three plots and posts a bond per plot. At random epochs an audit gale, rerun publicly by peers, compares behavior across all plants; when two move like one operator, their gardeners lose those bonds and the plots stay barren a season. So n clones need n plots from n honest gardeners risking real stake, and each newcomer holds zero weight until the dawn of its third season.
